title: PH60303: Introduction To Quantum Field Theory I
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Canonical Quantization, Elements of classical field theory ; symmetries and
Noether s theorem ; solitons ; canonical quantization ; creation-annihilation
operators; quantization of Klein-Gordon field and Dirac field; discrete
symmetries of the Dirac theory; interacting fields - pertubation theory, Wick s
theorem, Feynman diagrams, cross sections and S-matrix, S-matrix elements from
Feynman diagrams, Feynman rules for QED ; elementary processes of QED ; Compton
scattering ; non-perturbative methods - field and mass renormalization ; LSZ
reduction formula ; renormalized charge and Ward Identities. Path Integrals
Functional methods - path Integrals in quantum mechanics, functional
quantization of scalar fields, correlation functions, Feynman rules, functional
derivatives and generating functional, QFT and statistical mechanics,
quantization of the electromagnetic field, functional quantization of spinor
fields.
